status: PRE-EXECUTION LOCK; exploratory source-informed extension, NOT author-original parity
hypothesis: On known-q synthetic positive-only feedback, GADU can certify an optimal family with lower-dimensional action space, but finite mandatory search may outweigh realized continuation savings versus immediate original-T optimized Cover-UCB.
primary_estimand: Paired source-level cumulative latent pseudo-regret difference (GADU minus immediate Cover-UCB) at T=10000000, per locked fixed world; positive means higher GADU regret
delay_law: success event with D=1 with probability q_w; else D=4; failure emits silence; windowed observed Y=Z*1[D<=1]/q_w; source id recorded
time_semantics: Before decision t, matured sample v<=min(t-1,t-w). During testing, compare using all testing sources v<=t-w after action t. Fresh continuation starts with no prior testing sources.

Base Cover radius chosen before actions at T and frozen; accepted singleton retunes remaining horizon. Search takes M_actual*m_search+w. Conservative feasibility test uses envelope Mbar. Actual D_T uses actual T_init.
